widgets_values:
## LTX-2.5 SINGLE-STAGE keyframes + optional dialog - RTX 3090

**Length**: group 2 `duration seconds` (auto-snapped to 8n+1: 5 s -> 121, 8 s -> 193, 10 s -> 241 @ 24 fps). Longer clips need more VRAM.
**Resolution**: width/height (/32) = final size (no stage-2 upscale). Defaults to 768x768 for safe 3090 VRAM; raise only if you have headroom, or use the Optional Two-Stage workflow for 1024x1024 / 1080p.

**Keyframes (3–4+ images, anti-drift)**
- START: required. END: on by default (same characters, final positions). No END wanted -> Ctrl+B the `END guide` node.
- MID-A / MID-B: bypassed by default. To use one: select your image, then Ctrl+B its LoadImage + preprocess + guide node.
- Set `frame_idx` to the frame where the image should appear (e.g. 8 s / 193 f: 96 for 3 images, or 64 & 128 for 4 images; 5 s / 121 f: 60 for 3 images). Keep `frame_idx` below total frames.
- Keyframes should share the same scene/characters/lighting with only poses/positions changing.

**Dialog audio (pre-generated voices)**
- Bypassed by default -> LTX generates its own audio/speech from the prompt.
- To use your track: select your audio file, then Ctrl+B the 4 nodes in group 4c + the `Use dialog audio` node. The audio is locked (mask 0) and auto-fitted to clip length so LTX lip-syncs to it.
- Describe in the prompt who speaks which line so the right mouth moves.

nodes.title: HOW TO: Length, Resolution & 3+ Images
widgets_values:
## QUICK GUIDE: Length, Resolution & 3+ Images (1-Stage)

### 1. How to change LENGTH (duration)
- Change **`duration seconds`** in Group 2. Keep **fps = 24**.
- Frame count auto-snaps to **`8n + 1`**:

| Duration | Frames @24fps | 3 images (MID-A) | 4 images (MID-A / MID-B) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 4 s | 97 | 48 | 32 / 64 |
| 5 s | 121 | 60 | 40 / 80 |
| 6 s | 145 | 72 | 48 / 96 |
| **8 s** | **193** | **96** | **64 / 128** |
| 10 s | 241 | 120 | 80 / 160 |

- Keep any enabled `frame_idx` **below total frames** (`-1` = last frame).

### 2. How to change RESOLUTION (must be ÷ 32)
- Edit **`width`** and **`height`** in Group 2 — this IS your **final video size** (no upscale).

| Aspect | Fast / Safe on 3090 (8s) | Higher Detail (5s–8s) |
|---|---|---|
| 1:1 Square | `512×512` or `768×768` | `832×832` (1024×1024 may OOM @8s) |
| 16:9 Wide | `768×448` or `832×480` | `960×544` |
| 9:16 Vertical | `448×768` or `480×832` | `544×960` |

### 3. How to use 3 or 4 guiding images
- **START** + **END** are ON by default.
- To enable **MID-A** (3rd) or **MID-B** (4th):
  1. Select its LoadImage + preprocess + guide node -> press **Ctrl+B** (un-bypass).
  2. Pick your image and set `frame_idx` on the guide node (see table above).
- To disable **END**: select `END guide` -> **Ctrl+B**.

### 4. Custom Dialog Audio (optional)
- Select the 4 nodes in Group 4c + `Use dialog audio` -> **Ctrl+B**, then load your audio file.
- Audio is locked (mask 0) and auto-fitted to clip length so LTX lip-syncs to it.

### 5. If Out of Memory (3090 24 GB)
1. Lower `VAEDecodeTiled` `tile_size`: `512` -> `384` -> `256`.
2. Lower width/height or duration (e.g. 8s -> 5s).
3. Switch to `OptionalTwoStage` for 1024×1024 / 1080p (Stage 1 low res -> ×2 refine).
